what: Tickets live in the target's tracker, not GitHub Issues only; the lane record's issue key holds the lane key.
why: Owner ruling (2026-10-22, issue #82): the kit works with Linear directly so it can run on a Linear-first repository; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says 'tickets live in GitHub Issues only' (octo-lane-record-tickets); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target.

what: New Factory report section: octo-feather-lane report prints each open lane's pull request and checks, Herdr agents, waits (waiting_on, pending owner gates, running checks), wall time, review rounds, spend and gate time, an owner queue, and owner-caught finding counts from the director log; read-only over existing files, Herdr and GitHub, facts only. The director log gains its finding kind; boundary-lane-files names the report as a reader.
why: Owner rulings on issue #137 (2026-10-27): one read-only kit command so the director always has the whole factory's context; minimal scope is what each lane runs and waits on (owner waits included), per-lane wall time, review rounds and spend, plus owner-caught classes by count; gh234 proposed per-lane gate time and the owner-wait queue as that lesson's rung-1 fix. Goes to owner review and Accept before any lane code.
evidence: No criterion in the comms spec at a26a417 covers a factory report: grep -c report-  docs/specs/comms.spec.html at main a67c325 prints 0; director log finding owner-caught-waits-invisible and owner-caught-stranded-unseen (2026-10-27): the director had to read panes to know lanes were waiting on CI.
